finding: A diagnostic refresh could overwrite a previously confirmed sinkchange with selected-unverified because publish(context, false) discarded prior evidence.

implementation.behavior: Confirmation is retained in a WeakSet keyed by the exact AudioContext instance; unrelated contexts remain unconfirmed.

cases: sinkchange promotes the context to selected-confirmed
later diagnostic refresh cannot downgrade the same context
confirmation does not leak to another context instance

runtime_limit: This proves browser-state evidence monotonicity in the contract runtime. It does not prove physical speaker emission, listener perception, or that Vercel currently serves the new commits.

deployment_check.reason: The execution environment could not resolve the public hostname, so no deployment claim is made.
